About Lantern Dao

A small survivors-like set in a valley that keeps its own weather. Every building, tree, ruin and creature was modelled headlessly in Blender from primitives and shipped as one 1.8 MB kit; the world, the crowds and the light are assembled at runtime in three.js.

The loop. Demons born of sha pour in from the mist. Cut them down, gather the spirit stones they drop, and choose a technique at every breakthrough. Spirit crystals buy permanent refinements at the refinery in the Gate Market. Thirty seconds before the eighth minute the sky closes in; then the Tribulation Lord descends. Hold out ten minutes and the clouds part.

Districts. The Hearth, The Wildwood, Mossfall Ruins, Cinder Barrow, Silvermere Shore. Each favours different enemies.

Lantern Dao is the xianxia re-skin of Emberlight, itself inspired by 歸藏's GPT-6 Astra + Blender + Godot original. Every building, tree and demon was modelled headlessly in Blender 5.2 from primitives; the valley, the crowds, the weather and the tribulation run in three.js r184, and every sound is synthesised in WebAudio.
